description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Home: * Walk to Dune Allen Regional Beach Access* 4 Bikes Included – cruise Scenic 30A with ease* Private garage game room with air hockey, foosball, darts, and Pac-Man arcade fun for all ages! * 4 complimentary beach chairs included for the perfect beach day! * Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery + Redfish Village* 2 miles to Gulf Place Town Center (west)* 2 miles to Grayton Beach State Park (east)* Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support*Age Requirement: Must be 25+ to book. No exceptions.*Snowbirds Welcome! Monthly winter stays (Jan–Feb) available, call for details. **Please note there is new construction starting near by, noise may be heard*Welcome to Emerald Escape, your ideal 30A getaway just minutes from the sugar-white sand and emerald Gulf waters, and a short stroll to the community pool. This beautifully styled 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home blends coastal charm with family-friendly comfort. The open-concept first floor is perfect for gathering, featuring a bright kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, dining for six, and additional island seating. The first-floor master suite offers a king bed and a spacious private bath, along with a convenient half bath and laundry room. Upstairs, a cozy loft creates a second living space—perfect for movie nights or a kids’ hangout. You’ll find a second king master suite, another king guest room, and a bunk room with full-over-full and twin XL bunks, ideal for larger groups or teens.The fun continues in the game room with air hockey, foosball, and darts great for unwinding after a beach day. With plenty of space, thoughtful amenities, and a prime location, Emerald Escape is designed for a memorable 30A vacation.The Bed Set Up:1st FloorMaster Suite: King Bed + private ensuite bath2nd FloorMaster Bedroom 2: King Bed + private ensuite bathGuest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed + XL Twin-over- XL Twin Bunk BedSerenity at Dune Allen sits on the quiet west end of Scenic 30A, close to everything, but away from the crowds. Hop on the paved bike path and explore beach towns, boutiques, and local dining. Location, Location, Location!!You’re minutes from:Grayton Beach State ParkSeaside, WaterColor, Seacrest, and Rosemary BeachGulf Place shopping + diningLocal favorites like Blue Mountain Beach Creamery-Adventure Awaits: Sea Turtle ReefSnorkelers will love the nearby Sea Turtle Reef, located just offshore near Grayton Beach. This artificial reef has become a thriving marine habitat perfect for spotting fish and sea life. For the best experience, bring a paddleboard or kayak and always monitor sea conditions.-Why 30A?Sugar-white sand. Emerald green water. A laid-back luxury vibe you can’t replicate anywhere else. Bike rides at sunset. Ice cream after dinner. Barefoot beach mornings. Read less
